question: How stable are consequential institutional interpretations across three fresh AI contexts coding identical source material under frozen project specification 0.3?
selection: Reuse all 24 Round 4 records: 12 purposive, 6 deterministically sampled candidate-bearing, 6 deterministically sampled excluded records. No new selection based on Round 12 outputs.
context: Identical union of the latest source-only Round 4 A, B v2, and C supplemented packets; 98 entries. Includes prior source-only supplements uniformly before dispatch. No prior annotation, narrative conclusion, or reconciliation ledger supplied.
unit: Source record for screening; aligned institutional proposition for field comparisons. Statements within a record are not independent observations.
model_configuration: Inherited parent configuration in three fresh contexts; no model override. Not a comparison of distinct models. Actual provider snapshot, sampling seed, temperature, tokens and costs are unexposed.
independence: No parent conversational history inherited. Same input bytes and prompt apart from reviewer ID and own directory. Shared filesystem has no technical isolation; access restricted by instructions and disclosed by reviewers. No claim of statistical independence or training-data novelty.
execution: One complete annotation per reviewer. Preserve first complete output and mechanical checker feedback; permit mechanical repairs and one self-review before final freeze. No cross-reviewer or baseline feedback before all outputs freeze. Record all revisions. Missing context requests are logged; if necessary, identical source-only supplements go to all reviewers and original outputs remain frozen.
alignment: After freeze, group statements by source and preserved proposition meaning. Exact spans are deterministic candidates; nonexact matching requires an explicit source-based rationale. Permit one-to-many alignment only when split/combined units retain the same full proposition. Mark ambiguous alignments unresolved. Context-unit counts are not quality scores.
metrics: Exact-span matched statements and unpaired records
Source-based semantic alignment coverage with separate one-to-one and split/combined groups
Raw field agreement for grammar, force, type, standing, dispute flag, statement target level and observed action level on one-to-one triples, with explicit denominators
Source-grounded differences in actor/object scope, material conditions, recognition targets, and disposition versus application
Audit unanimous as well as disputed interpretations; preserve defensible alternatives and shared errors
scoring: Report descriptive agreement, not an accuracy estimate. No passing threshold, inferential significance tests, or population generalization. Higher labels are not automatically preferred. Source reconciliation is an additional revisable AI judgment, never a gold standard.
baseline_comparison: Only after all three fresh annotations are frozen. Compare consequential findings with corrected Round 4 / inherited Round 11 records. Propose changes in a separate ledger; do not silently rewrite prior packages or manuscripts.
scope: Step one only: overlapping AI validation of the 2025 GitHub material. No later fork extension and no merged manuscript drafting.
